# Speech fixture provenance

`speech.wav` is the CMU US BDL ARCTIC v0.95 recording originally named
`wav/arctic_a0004.wav`. It says: “Lord, but I'm glad to see you again, Phil.”

Source:

The audio was copied byte-for-byte and renamed from `arctic_a0004.wav` to
`speech.wav`; its samples and container were not modified. It is 16-bit mono
PCM at 16 kHz with a duration of approximately 2.575 seconds.

Carnegie Mellon University permits this voice to be used, copied, modified,
and licensed for any purpose subject to the retained conditions and
disclaimer. The release's license text is retained verbatim alongside the
fixture as `CMU_ARCTIC_LICENSE.txt`; only its leading and trailing blank lines
were removed.
